purpose: Teach: 属する/従う/密接/超過/所在/着手/急増/取り上げる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、業界団体に、絶対、属する、絶対、責任、絶対、果たしてきたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: From the founding, Dad committed absolutely to belonging to the industry association and fulfilling that responsibility with complete seriousness.
lines.style: Quiet, weathered voice. Measured pace. Each phrase lands with deliberate weight—not rushed, but carrying the gravity of decades. Steady breath. A man reflecting on legacy without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、法令に、絶対、従う、絶対、姿勢、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we have continued his stance of absolutely adhering to the law with the utmost seriousness. I'm truly grateful for that foundation.
lines.style: Formal but sincere. Clear diction on 「従う」 — commitment stated plainly, not performed. Respectful pace. The voice of a son honoring his father's discipline while making it his own.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、お得意様と、絶対、密接、絶対、な、絶対、絆、絶対、築いたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Dad built close, enduring relationships with our valued clients—and I mean truly strong bonds, with absolute seriousness.
lines.style: Nostalgic, slightly softer than before. Breath carries a faint wistfulness on the opening. Pace slows just perceptibly when speaking of the bonds themselves. The voice of someone remembering what was done well.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、予算、絶対、超過、絶対、絶対なきよう、絶対、徹底してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's era, we have maintained absolute discipline—never exceeding budget, never overstepping. I'm grateful for that rigorous standard.
lines.style: Steady, almost austere. No flourish. Each clause delivered with quiet conviction. Slight emphasis on the negative framing—what was NOT allowed—as the true measure of integrity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、責任の、絶対、所在、絶対、いつも、絶対、明確にしたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Dad always made the source of responsibility crystal clear—there was never any ambiguity about who was accountable.
lines.style: Firmer now, almost sharp. Pride in the bone structure of accountability. Breath is controlled. Pace picks up slightly—this is foundational, and he wants it heard as such. No trailing off.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、新規事業に、絶対、着手、絶対、される姿、絶対、私の手本です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The way my father undertook new ventures—that willingness to take initiative and risk—that is my model. I'm truly grateful for his example.
lines.style: Warm but measured. Slight softening on 「手本」. Not effusive, but genuine—the voice of a son acknowledging influence without becoming sentimental. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、お客様の、絶対、急増、絶対、誇りに思ったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Dad took real pride in our rapid growth—in the surge of clients and success. He felt that pride deeply.
lines.style: Voice lifting just slightly, warmer. A rare moment of unguarded feeling. Breath less controlled here—this was joy he witnessed. Pace relaxed just perceptibly. The old man allowing himself to remember something good.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、社員の意見を、絶対、取り上げる、絶対、社風、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. From my father's time until now, we have carried forward the culture of listening to our employees, valuing their voices. That tradition continues, and I'm deeply grateful for it.
lines.style: Closing tone—reflective and complete. Slower pace. Each element of the legacy named clearly, like closing chapters of a book. Breath is deep and settled. The voice of someone who has inherited well and knows it.
